svg.aria-label: Ask the Filings: ingestion downloads 10-K filing HTML from SEC EDGAR, flattens tables to label and value rows, cuts 400-word chunks tagged with their 10-K Item, embeds them locally with bge-small and stores them in Postgres with pgvector and a full-text index. For each question it detects the company named, runs embedding and keyword search, merges them with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, reranks the top 30 with a local bge-reranker-base and sends the top 8 to Gemini, which answers in JSON. Output checks withhold answers without a valid citation and flag numbers not in the cited passages. 111 of 117 answerable questions correct with no wrong answers, 26 of 27 unanswerable refused, at $0.007 and 5.5 seconds per question.
